activity.notes: Fourier presented his key 1807 memoir on propagation of heat and later developed and published Théorie analytique de la chaleur in 1822. The bounded 1807–1822 representative scholarly interval captures the founding publications of Fourier heat analysis, not his separate prefectural administrative office.
